scripts.build:tenantd: npm run build --workspace @ctlflow/test-mesh && npm run build --workspace @ctlflow/auditd && npm run build --workspace @ctlflow/identityd && npm run build --workspace @ctlflow/policyd && npm run build --workspace @ctlflow/tenantd
scripts.test:tenantd: npm run build:tenantd && npm run test:compiled --workspace @ctlflow/tenantd && npm run test:csharp --workspace @ctlflow/tenantd
scripts.verify:migration-container:tenantd: docker build --network=host -f services/tenantd/migrations/Containerfile -t ctlflow-tenantd-migrations:verify . && docker run --rm --tmpfs /data:rw,mode=1777 -e CTLFLOW_DATABASE_PATH=/data/tenantd.sqlite ctlflow-tenantd-migrations:verify
